exclusions.reason: No per-export native execution receipt importer; every native-execution flag remains false.

Export calls do not enumerate internal branches, error/race/OOM/IRQL/teardown behavior. Six owned replacement associations are manual host-test mappings only.
External XISO catalog and historical run summaries are context, not imported new passes. Header-expanded and non-C guest calls are not enumerated.
No accepted before/after extraction comparison; A/A calibration, exact candidate build and remaining P1 structural/durability/native gates required.
No inference of physical Xbox qualification or every release/checked/64/128MB path from source inventory.

limitations: Direct invocation means a lexical callsite in a test function body, not proven symbol binding, reachability or execution.
Conditional regions, address-taken references and declaration-like sites receive symbol-reference evidence only.
Compiler preprocessing, local shadowing, macro expansion, call graphs, function pointers, internal paths and line/branch coverage are not resolved.
No native receipts are imported or authenticated. Historical documents remain manual evidence only.
Missing source evidence means untested in this inventory, not proof that no test exists elsewhere.
